latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — provides a systematic approach for quantifying and reporting architecture risk.

- Introduces a 2D risk matrix (impact x likelihood, scored 1–9) to evaluate risk across components or services.
- Supports standard and custom risk criteria: scalability, availability, performance, security, and data integrity.
- Guides users to gather required system context (architecture, technology stack, risk concerns) before assessment.
- Outputs clear, structured risk assessment reports suitable for stakeholder meetings.
- Automatically triggers when users mention risk-related scenarios, unproven technology, or want a risk heat map or risk scoring.
